entities.summary: Adesio Rafael Lombardo Rossi was a Uruguayan basketball player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics and in the 1952 Summer Olympics. Lombardo was part of the Uruguayan basketball team, which finished fifth in the 1948 tournament. Four years later Lombardo was a member of the Uruguayan team, which won the bronze medal. He played all eight matches.
